title: Voting Begins for the 2026 National Thanksgiving Turkey Pardon Ceremony
---
 
President Donald J. Trump will celebrate a uniquely American
Thanksgiving tradition as the White House hosts the 79th National
Thanksgiving Turkey presentation and pardoning ceremony on Tuesday,
November 24, 2026.

This year’s turkeys, named **Freedom** and **Feathers** by the American
people via an online poll last week, were raised in West Virginia, under
the direction of National Turkey Federation Chairwoman Christy
Puffenbarger, by owners of Deans Gap Farm Scott and Becky Rightsell.

Each year, two turkeys are officially pardoned by the President of the
United States, but only one receives the ceremonial honor at the White
House. Following a final public poll on
[WhiteHouse.Gov/Thanksgiving](https://www.whitehouse.gov/thanksgiving/),
one of these two turkeys will be ceremonially pardoned at the White
House on Tuesday, November 24, 2026. Both turkeys will live out their
days at Texas A&M following the ceremony.

**The American public is now invited to decide which turkey will take
center stage during the pardon ceremony hosted by President Trump by
voting [here](https://www.whitehouse.gov/thanksgiving/#vote).**

**Voting will conclude the night of Monday, November 23, 2026, at 11:59
PM.**
